title: Mobile Video Directly Observed Therapy (DOT) for Immunosuppression Medication Adherence in Adolescent Heart Transplant Recipients
official: Mobile Video Directly Observed Therapy (DOT) for Immunosuppression Medication Adherence in Adolescent Heart Transplant Recipients: Enhancing Technological Innovation and Strengthening the Role of Small Businesses in Meeting Needs of Adolescent Organ Transplant
summary: We will conduct a two-group randomized controlled trial to examine the eMocha DOT intervention with pediatric HT recipients.In this population, medication nonadherence remains a primary cause of late acute rejection (LAR) episodes, increased number of hospitalizations, graft failure, and patient mortality. Herein, we propose an innovative approach to promote medication adherence and improve patient and graft outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Eligible participants are 10-21 years of age
* Have received a heart transplant and are followed participating pediatric heart transplant centers
* English-speaking or Spanish-speaking
* Own a smart-phone or have access to the mobile app through other devices
* Are willing to receive information through it
* Have a MLVI score of greater than 2.0 over the last year

Exclusion Criteria:

• Those with cognitive impairments will not be eligible for enrollment due to inability to provide informed assent

sites.f: University of Miami, Miller School of Medicine
